title: On the Strong Quasiconvexity of Norms and Distance Functions
summary: This paper studies the strong quasiconvexity of norm and distance functions in finite-dimensional normed spaces. Although the Euclidean norm is known to be strongly quasiconvex on bounded convex sets, a complete characterization of this property for general norms remains open. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for a norm function to be strongly quasiconvex on a convex set. We also initiate the study of the strong quasiconvexity of distance functions.
